items.title: Amgen's Forward Multiple Looks Cheap Until You Price The Margins It Assumes
items.summary: Amgen (AMGN) trades at about $393 a share. On the last twelve months of adjusted earnings, that is a trailing multiple of about 23.3 times. With Prolia and XGEVA sales falling to biosimilar rivals, the multiple looks full. What the forecast underneath it asks for is a wider margin while the company funds MariTide.

items.title: Could AstraZeneca (AZN)’s Stronger Growth Make it a Better Bet than Amgen (AMGN)?
items.summary: On August 27, AstraZeneca PLC (NYSE:AZN) and Amgen Inc. (NASDAQ:AMGN) scored a shared clinical victory. Positive high-level results from the Phase III CROSSING trial showed that their co-developed severe asthma drug, TEZSPIRE, achieved statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements across both co-primary endpoints, histologic remission and the frequency/severity of dysphagia, and all key secondary endpoints […]
